post.hook: Heat is not a flavor. It's a distraction.
post.copy:
Heat is not a flavor. It's a distraction.

Most sauces hide behind chili and call it a personality. Ours don't need to.

A sauce has four jobs on Wagyu: cut the fat, carry the salt, wake up the sweet, hold the finish. Miss one and the whole bite falls flat. Nail all four and you understand why we make 18 of them from scratch every morning — no premixes, ever.

So before you reach for the hottest one, ask what your bite actually needs. Fat to cut? Go acid. Beef too quiet? Go umami. Craving loud? That's what heat is for — the exclamation mark, never the sentence.

Old school science. Still hits.

post.hook: Wagyu. Nothing else touches the grill.
post.copy:
Wagyu. Nothing else touches the grill.

Every burger on this menu — from the OG Cheeseburger to the Foie Gras Deluxe — is built on 100% Wagyu. No swaps. No cheaper cut hiding under the sauce.

We don't lead with the beef because the sauce is the point. But the beef earns the right to carry 18 sauces made from scratch every morning.

Wagyu holds the flavour. The sauce finishes it. You glove up and take it from there.

post.hook: Your sauce combo is your signature. Show us.
post.copy:
Nobody dips the same way twice. Some of you drown it. Some of you build a two-sauce map across the box. Some of you pour Tom Yum on the OG and call it art.

That's the point. The last move is yours.

Glove up. Choose your finish from the 18. Pour it your way. Then post the box and tag us — we're building a wall of Sathorn's most unhinged sauce combos.
